## About
Pete's Complete Auto Repair is a family-owned shop on Foothill Blvd in Tujunga, run by Pete and his sons, Paul and Victor. Our certified technicians work on all makes and models of foreign and domestic vehicles, from scheduled maintenance to engine repair.
We are an official California STAR-Certified Smog Inspection Station, and we also sell low-priced tires, do wheel alignments and take care of automatic and manual transmissions.
Neighbors have given us a 4.6 rating from 140 Google reviews. Call us for an estimate and we will tell you straight what your car needs.

## Services
- Auto repair and maintenance: Scheduled maintenance, oil changes and fluid flushes, tune-ups, radiator and hose work, timing belts, water and fuel pumps, power steering, suspension work and engine repair for cars, trucks, vans, SUVs and hybrids.
- Check engine light inspection: If a warning light comes on, bring it in and we will look into what is causing it.
- Smog check and repair: We are an official STAR-Certified station, so we can test your car and fix it if it doesn't pass.
- Low-priced tires and tire services: Tires for all vehicle makes and models at low prices, plus a range of tire services.
- Wheel alignment: A professional alignment keeps your car driving straight and helps your tires last longer.
- Transmission inspection and repair: Service for automatic and manual transmissions, including all wheel drive vehicles, clutch replacement, gearboxes and flywheels.
- Pre-purchase inspection: Thinking about buying a used car? One reviewer came in for a pre-purchase inspection and said Paul took the time to listen and give good advice.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies and warranties?
A: Yes. We work with insurance companies and vehicle warranties.

Q: Are estimates free?
A: Yes, estimates are free. A diagnostics fee may apply depending on the work.

Q: Is the transmission inspection free?
A: Yes. Bring your vehicle in for a free transmission inspection and road test.

Q: Can you pick up my car?
A: If your car can be driven, we offer local pickup and delivery within 2 miles of the shop. Call us for details.
